findings.title: Decisions take twice the promised time
findings.detail: The bank promises a decision in 3 working days; the median is 7 and the worst cases pass 12.
findings.speaker: Deborah
findings.quote: Our median is seven working days, and the worst cases go past twelve.

findings.title: 4,200 documents waiting
findings.detail: The backlog has been growing since March, when the new app increased volumes without new headcount.
findings.speaker: Deborah
findings.quote: Right now we have 4,200 documents waiting for an analyst.

findings.title: Business accounts eat analyst time
findings.detail: About 15% of applications, but about 40% of analyst time: company documents need cross-checks of directors and owners.
findings.speaker: Deborah
findings.quote: They are only about 15 percent of applications, but they take about 40 percent of my analysts' time.

findings.title: Copy-typing fields between two screens
findings.detail: Analysts retype names, dates and addresses from the document viewer into CaseFlow, sometimes several times per case.
findings.speaker: Tom
findings.quote: I copy-type the key fields into CaseFlow, because CaseFlow can't read the documents itself.

findings.title: Nearly a third of applications need rework
findings.detail: 31% get at least one 'ask applicant': old proof of address, blurred photos, name mismatches.
findings.speaker: Tom
findings.quote: About 31 percent of applications get at least one "ask applicant".

findings.title: Resubmitted cases start again
findings.detail: A resent document goes back into the queue, usually to another analyst, who reviews the whole case again.
findings.speaker: Tom
findings.quote: It goes back into the queue, usually to a different analyst, who starts the case again from the beginning.

findings.title: January peak doubles volume
findings.detail: Volumes double every January, beyond what the team can handle.
findings.speaker: Deborah
findings.quote: Every January we get twice as many applications as we can handle.

findings.title: Show how sure it is, and where each answer came from
findings.detail: The 2024 OCR pilot failed because every field looked equally certain. Analysts need confidence and the source on the page.
findings.speaker: Deborah
findings.quote: My analysts will not trust a tool that can't show them where an answer came from.

findings.title: Point to the problem part of a document
findings.detail: Analysts want to see at once which part of a document needs attention instead of reading all of it.
findings.speaker: Tom
findings.quote: show me straight away which part of a document is the problem

findings.title: A full audit trail
findings.detail: Who decided what, when, and on what evidence must be recorded for every decision.
findings.speaker: Helen
findings.quote: we must be able to show a regulator who decided what, when, and on what evidence.

findings.title: Back inside three days before January
findings.detail: Most customers should get a decision within 3 working days before the January peak.
findings.speaker: Helen
findings.quote: If we're back inside three working days for most customers before the January peak

findings.title: A person makes every KYC decision
findings.detail: The tool may prepare, highlight and suggest; an analyst decides and is accountable. Not negotiable.
findings.speaker: Helen
findings.quote: A tool can prepare, highlight and suggest, but an analyst decides and is accountable.

findings.title: MLRO sign-off and model validation first
findings.detail: Changes to KYC controls need the MLRO's sign-off and an independent model validation, about 3 weeks.
findings.speaker: Helen
findings.quote: anything that uses a model needs an independent model validation before it goes into production.

findings.title: Customer documents stay in the UK
findings.detail: Processing must stay in the bank's AWS London region; public AI chat tools are blocked.
findings.speaker: Helen
findings.quote: Customer documents must not leave the UK.

findings.title: CaseFlow is read-only
findings.detail: The API can read cases but not write; a vendor change took 8 weeks last time.
findings.speaker: Tom
findings.quote: CaseFlow has an API, but it's read-only for us.

findings.title: How can we use the 18 months of review history?
findings.detail: 61,000 reviews with decisions and reason codes exist; the MLRO must agree how an export is handled.
findings.speaker: Deborah
findings.quote: but it contains customer data, so Helen will need to agree how.

findings.title: What targets will the sponsor set?
findings.detail: Martin judges cost per application (about £11.40) and abandonment (22% give up after 5 days); targets are not agreed yet.
findings.speaker: Deborah
findings.quote: Cost per application, which is about £11.40 today, and abandonment.
